*[[Sunflower Student Movement|Sunflower Student Movement in Taiwan]]:

*[[2014 French municipal elections]]:
**Voters in France go to the polls for a second round of voting in municipal elections. The ruling [[Socialist Party (France)|Socialist Party]] generally performs badly, but their candidate in the [[2014 Paris municipal election|Paris mayoral election]] [[Anne Hidalgo]] is set to become the first female mayor of that city.
